request.initial_prompt: The same Covenant was renewed with Isaac; and afterwards with Jacob; but afterwards no more, till the Israelites were freed from the Egyptians, and arrived at the Foot of Mount Sinai: and then it was renewed by Moses (as I have said before, chap. 35.) in such manner, as they became from that time forward the Peculiar Kingdome of God; whose Lieutenant was Moses, for his owne time; and the succession to that office was setled upon Aaron, and his heirs after him, to bee to God a Sacerdotall Kingdome for ever.

raw_segments.text: The same Covenant was renewed with Isaac, and afterwards with Jacob, but afterwards no more,
till the Israelites were freed from the Egyptians, and arrived at the Foot of Mount Sinai, and
then it was renewed by Moses, as I have said before, chap. 35.) in such manner, as they
became from that time forward the Peculiar Kingdome of God, whose Lieutenant was Moses,
for his owne time. And the succession to that office was setled upon Aaron, and his
heirs after him, to bee to God a Sacerdotall Kingdome for ever.
